title: Obstacle Handling Policy Config
description: Validates config/obstacles.json per AGENTS.md Rule 7 and its tech convention (obstacle type -> enabled + detection_method + policy). The vocabulary defined here is canonical: add new obstacles/detectors/policies here first, then to obstacles.json. The forbidden CAPTCHA/stealth policies (solve, evasion, proxy rotation) are deliberately absent from the policy enum.

enabled.description: Whether this obstacle is actively detected and handled.

detection_method.description: Heuristic/DOM-based detection approach (never selector-based, per constitution).

policy.description: Canonical resolution policy. terminal_blocked = detect, log with reason, skip, move on (Rule 7: CAPTCHA/auth/hard access-control refusals are never solved or retried). flag_and_skip = flag for review and exclude from corpus (validation/content failures).

max_retries.description: Bounded retry budget for retry policies (Rule 5: bounded retry, then flag).

scope.description: Bounding note on when a policy applies (e.g. blocked_clicks retry applies only to transient flakiness).

reason.description: Why an obstacle is disabled or set to a particular policy.
